added.title: Director of Engineering
added.description:
About Lantern

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

Lantern Care is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Product Engineering organization. This role owns feature delivery across multiple engineering pods, partnering closely with Product and business stakeholders to translate roadmap priorities into shipped, high–quality software. You will report to the VP of Engineering and play a central role in maturing how our engineering teams plan, build, and iterate. This is a hands–on leadership role for someone who has run engineering teams before and wants to build the next chapter of Lantern’s delivery model – standing up new pods, championing iterative, loop–based development practices, and raising the bar on execution across the organization.

Location:
Hybrid - at least 3 days/week in our Dallas, TX offices

Responsibilities:

Manage the delivery for multiple product engineering pods, ensuring predictable, high-quality releases against roadmap commitments
Stand up and scale new engineering pods structured around iterative, agentic, loop-based development, defining team composition, cadence, and ways of working
Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into executable work with clear context and constraints
Maintain hands-on technical expertise in design, code, and deployments
Coach and develop engineering managers and senior engineers, building a strong bench of technical leadership
Drive engineering rigor and architecture standards via platform tools across the pods, including code quality, testing discipline, and architecture alignment, in partnership with QA and Architecture
Drive scaled hiring, performance management, and career growth for the Product Engineering team
Report on delivery health, velocity, risks, and escalations to senior leadership
Champion adoption and experimental scale of Lantern’s AI-assisted SDLC tooling and practices within your pods

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering managers or senior technical leads
Track record of standing up or restructuring engineering teams around new delivery models, such as pod-based or iterative, loop-based development
Deep experience partnering with Product and QA to ship complex, customer-facing software at scale
Strong technical judgment across modern architecture, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD practices
Experience operating in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent environment is a plus
7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong proficiency in .NET Core, C#, Typescript, and/or Python
Proven experience leading software development teams specializing in web applications and integrations.
Experience in modern JavaScript frameworks, NET Core, C#, Typescript, Python, REST APIs, SQL, etc.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Cloud-based development (Azure preferred)

Strong Candidates Will:

Move fast without sacrificing quality, balancing urgency with sound engineering judgment
Communicate clearly and directly with both engineers and executive stakeholders
Have built or scaled pod-based engineering structures from the ground up with direct connection to the business for rapid, iterative development
Coach engineering managers, not just individual contributors
Bring a builder’s mindset to process, comfortable defining how a new team should work rather than just executing an existing playbook

Benefits

Medical Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Short & Long Term Disability
Life Insurance
401k with company match
Flexible Time Off
Paid Parental Leave

About You:

You use LOGIC in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.
INCLUSION
is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.
You have the GRIT, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas.
You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep HUMANITY in all decisions. Your customers aren’t just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change.
Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the TRUTH vs. giving people the answers they want to hear.
You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change.

These pillars of LIGHT
are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this LIGHT
, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life.

If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern.

Please apply to our role & someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process.

added.description:

Meet the Team

Enterprise AI Platforms & Infrastructure (EAIPI) powers Cisco’s digital transformation by owning and operating the full infrastructure stack—including data centers, GPU clusters, storage, orchestration, and full-stack observability—within a complex hybrid-cloud environment. Our mission is to provide robust AI and infrastructure capabilities to Cisco’s global enterprise, product business units, and workforce. We operate as "Customer Zero," partnering with Cisco product organizations to validate new technologies under real-world production conditions, ensuring operational excellence and reliability before external release. There is a strong preference for candidates based in San Jose (SJC) or Milpitas, California or Raleigh-Durham (RTP), North Carolina, to enable onsite collaboration 2-3 days per week.

Your Impact

As the Director of Cloud Operations, you will lead the strategy, engineering, and operational excellence of Cisco’s enterprise multi-cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, and others). Positioned at the intersection of infrastructure, security, developer velocity, and financial efficiency, you will influence how thousands of Cisco engineers build and operate cloud workloads. You will define and enforce cloud governance and compliance, drive developer enablement through a product-led approach, manage enterprise FinOps and cloud economics, and lead cloud operations toward autonomous, AI-native infrastructure. Success in this role means maintaining 24/7 operational resilience, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and scaling a diverse, world-class engineering organization.

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years of progressive cloud engineering experience, including 5+ years in senior leadership managing managers and technical leads in large enterprises.
10+ years of expertise in multi-cloud architecture and operations across AWS, Azure, GCP, and hybrid environments.
5+ years of experience scaling FinOps frameworks, governance models, and cost-management tools (e.g., Cloudability or cloud-native tools).
5+ years of experience of modern SRE practices, observability platforms (Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and CI/CD automation.

Basic Qualifications

AWS/GCP Professional Certifications and FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP).
Experience with agentic workflows, AIOps, and AI-driven automation in enterprise IT.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale organizational transformations and complex platform migrations.
Exceptional communication skills to translate complex technical requirements into executive business strategy.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

added.description:
About 14 Technology Holdings

14 Technology Holding’s (“14TH”) portfolio includes Data Analytics firms in multiple spaces and employs over 100 people. Our team of analysts, scientists, engineers, and strategists hail from diverse backgrounds yet share a passion for using data to solve the world’s greatest social and analytical challenges. Since our inception, we’ve worked with more than 400 organizations across the world. We service an ever-expanding portfolio of commercial clients in the automotive, travel, CPG, entertainment, healthcare, media, and telecom industries. Along the way, we’ve developed some of the most innovative tools available in analytics, media optimization, reporting, and influencer outreach.

About the team

The Engineering team at 14TH supports application access, asset management, and broader operational logistics. We work with a number of internal stakeholders across the organization, supporting the underlying infrastructure and data pipelines that allow the rest of the teams to conduct innovative analyses, propose innovative improvements in government operations, and hone messaging for important campaigns. We work in changing, ambiguous environments, so we embrace nuance and complexity to deliver programs that work for the diverse groups of individuals who rely on us. We’re a team of professionals with various work backgrounds and experiences who seek to make 14TH a more efficient, compliant, and positive place to work.

In this position you will:

Partner hand in hand with the Director of Data to translate platform and data strategy into engineering execution, operating as peers across the data organization.
Take an already high-performing data engineering team and keep it aligned with best practices — establishing, championing, and continuously reinforcing standards for modeling, transformation, testing, and documentation as the platform evolves.
Provide strategic direction and technical leadership to the data engineering team, defining and executing the data engineering roadmap in alignment with the broader business and data strategy.
Operate as a hands-on leader in a role split roughly 50% management / 50% individual contribution.
Define and maintain data architecture standards and best practices that ensure the consistency, reliability, and maintainability of data pipelines and systems.
Lead the design and implementation of data models and schemas that enable integration and analysis across the platform.
Architect and build complex data systems, including large-scale data migration projects.
Design, implement, and manage data pipelines, ETL processes, and data warehousing solutions for efficient ingestion, transformation, and storage.
Partner with the DevOps team to deploy new data prototypes and R&D initiatives.
Debug and optimize long-running queries, tuning pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability across data volume, velocity, and variety.
Recruit, hire, onboard, and mentor a high-performing data engineering team — setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and conducting performance evaluations.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive team environment that promotes professional growth and skill development.
Evaluate and select technologies, tools, and platforms that enhance data engineering capability and scale.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, software engineers, and other stakeholders to translate data requirements into solutions that meet business needs.
Partner with IT, security, and compliance teams to maintain data privacy, security, and compliance standards.
Monitor and troubleshoot data engineering processes, resolving issues quickly.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, driving innovation and continuous improvement across processes, tools, and methodologies.

8+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field, including 3+ years in a leadership/management role.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
Deep expertise in data pipeline design, ETL processes, data warehousing, and data integration.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python; familiarity with R is a plus.
Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data warehouses (Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake).
Solid command of database systems, data modeling, and schema design.
Proven ability to manage complex projects and deliver high-quality results on time.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.

added.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to Director, Hardware Systems
.

You Will

Define and execute Waymo’s global strategy for systems integration, diagnostics, vehicle commissioning, and field engineering across multiple vehicle platforms.
Lead, scale, and mentor a multidisciplinary engineering organization encompassing Systems Integration, Diagnostics, Scaled Commissioning, and Field Engineering.
Own end-to-end systems integration and bring-up of new Waymo Driver hardware and OEM vehicle platforms - spanning compute, sensor pipelines, vehicle networks, and system-level HIL testbeds, from early bench prototypes through autonomous fleet readiness.
Drive the architecture and development of next-generation diagnostics infrastructure, automated tooling, and telemetry to support high-volume manufacturing and fleet operations.
Establish, mature, and scale vehicle commissioning: end-of-line test, provisioning, calibration, etc. at manufacturing facilities and service centers around the world.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Hardware, Software, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and OEM partners to define integration requirements, triage complex system-level issues, and guide design-for-diagnostics and design-for-manufacturing feedback loops.

You Have

BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in systems engineering/integration, diagnostics, or integration for complex hardware/software systems (e.g., automotive, robotics, aerospace, defense).
5+ years of experience in people management, with a proven track record of leading and growing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Proven track record leading full-system hardware/software bring-up, HIL testbed architecture, and base-vehicle interface integration (power, networking, actuation, and ECU software/OTA) across multiple concurrent programs.
Deep technical breadth across electrical, mechanical, and software domains, with experience in HW/SW co-design and system-level debugging.
Experience scaling products from early-stage prototyping and low-volume to high-volume manufacturing or commercial fleet operations.
Strong partner management skills, with experience navigating and influencing external partners or OEM organizations.

We Prefer

Direct experience in the Autonomous Vehicle (AV), advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), automotive, industrial automation, or aerospace.
Experience with cloud-connected software-defined vehicles, diagnostics, and data-driven reliability engineering.
Experience managing global teams and vendor relationships for hardware integration and manufacturing.

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

Overview

Quorum is hiring a Sr. Director, Data Platform to own the vision, execution, adoption, and operation of a cross-segment data platform. The Data Platform is Quorum's corporate technical strategy for data, with strong backing from senior product segment leaders. Segments build on shared components instead of each building its own and choosing its own technology. The Quorum Agentic Platform sits on top of the Data Platform and uses its data for AI agents and agentic workflows.

The platform gives product segment teams paved roads: self-service tools, templates, and contracts that make segment-specific data work fast and consistent. The Data Platform team itself owns the cross-product data products that no single segment can own and delivers them with the Data Platform product manager.

The Sr. Director reports to the VP, Platform and Architecture, and leads a team of 4 to 8 engineers that builds and runs the platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership role and a thought leadership role in data: the Sr. Director shapes the architecture, works through production problems with the team, and sets the direction for data across all segments.

The role succeeds when product teams choose the platform because it helps them deliver faster.

Responsibilities

Platform Ownership

Be the single accountable owner for the platform, including its operation.
Own the Data Platform technical vision and architecture for both operational data and analytics.
Own adoption. Success is measured by product teams' use of the platform, faster integration and delivery, platform reliability, and less duplicated work across segments.
Advocate for the platform across the product segments: keep segment leaders informed of its capabilities and roadmap, and build strong working relationships with them.
Make the Data Platform the fastest way for engineers to deliver value within their own segment.
Own the delivery and operation of the cross-product data products that no single product line can own and build them on the platform.

Operational Data and Entity Resolution

Own entity resolution across Quorum products: one resolved record for each real-world entity, such as a well, a meter, or a business associate, with the source of every value recorded, and the survivorship rules that decide which system's value wins.
Own the event backbone and the publishing contract that product teams use to integrate with the platform.
Deliver resolved entities and their relationships to downstream consumers in near real time, including the Quorum Agentic Platform, with the reliability that product teams depend on.

Analytics Platform

Set the direction for ingestion, transformation, and curation of Quorum data in one governed analytics platform.
Standardize data for direct use by customers and third parties.
Own the strategy for how customers access their data, and build and run the APIs and other fit-for-purpose interfaces that deliver it, such as SQL endpoints and open data-sharing protocols.
Enable Quorum teams to explore governed data and build analytical and machine learning solutions using shared platform capabilities.
Own Quorum's external and internal reporting strategy: customer reporting through the analytics platform, and a shared reporting capability that Quorum applications can use instead of each building its own.

Data Governance

Own governance of cross-product datasets: ownership, cataloging, quality, and lineage.
Give product segments self-service governance for their own datasets, built into the platform, so they meet the same standards without building their own controls.
Own access control for operational and analytics data, including tenant isolation, so each customer sees only its own data.
Own data loss prevention (DLP) and the regulatory implications of data, in partnership with Security, Legal, and data owners.

Leadership

Lead the Data Platform engineering team of 4 to 8 engineers directly: hire, develop, and manage the people who build and run the platform.
Run the platform as a self-service product. Enable product teams to integrate with the platform easily, through contracts, templates, documentation, and automation.

Represent Quorum in data standards forums, such as OSDU.
Manage technical relationships with data platform vendors and partners.

And other duties as assigned.

Deep command of the full data platform: event streaming, entity resolution and master data management, ingestion, curation, and governance.
